3b89d3906d47eafce834582b229af4b6b2581840.overview: This randomized controlled trial is looking for adults aged 18 to 60 whose primary diagnosis is social anxiety disorder (SAD). The goals are to test feasibility, acceptability, how the therapy works and how well it works, and to use MRI to see how it affects brain activity.

inclusion.plain: Self-rated LSAS score is at least 50

inclusion.criterion: Fluent in English
inclusion.plain: Patient is fluent in English

inclusion.criterion: Normal or corrected-to-normal vision
inclusion.plain: Vision is normal or corrected to normal

exclusion.plain: Any lifetime psychosis, schizophrenia-spectrum disorder, or bipolar disorder

Complete an MRI safety screening questionnaire

inclusion.criterion: Diagnosis of moderate to severe MDD

exclusion.plain: Check allergy list for ketamine

exclusion.plain: Check allergy list for midazolam

e02ad7f228ab91683f7b8d9318ce127f379130da.overview: This observational study wants adults aged 18–55 with known or suspected temporal lobe epilepsy who are already in the hospital for intracranial electrode monitoring (sEEG with hippocampal coverage). The goal is to build the CAMERA platform. CAMERA combines brain, body, behavior and environmental sensor data with context-aware ecological momentary assessments (EMAs) and machine learning to predict anxiety state and memory performance moment to moment.

inclusion.criterion: Age 18 to 55 years, any sex
inclusion.plain: Check date of birth: 18–55 years

inclusion.criterion: Known or suspected Temporal Lobe Epilepsy
inclusion.plain: Confirm a TLE diagnosis or working TLE hypothesis in the epilepsy notes

inclusion.criterion: Native or proficient speaker of English or Spanish
inclusion.plain: Check preferred language and whether an interpreter is needed

inclusion.criterion: sEEG cases: implant plan includes hippocampal head, body, and tail electrodes, unilaterally or bilaterally
inclusion.plain: Check the sEEG implant plan for hippocampal head, body and tail contacts

inclusion.criterion: 7th grade reading level (minimum level considered literate for adults)
inclusion.plain: Confirm at least a 7th grade reading level (check education history or neuropsych testing)

exclusion.criterion: Hearing impaired (i.e., not corrected with a hearing aid)
exclusion.plain: Exclude hearing loss that a hearing aid does not correct

exclusion.criterion: Unable to read the newspaper at arm's length with corrective lenses
exclusion.plain: Exclude if corrected vision is not good enough to read a newspaper

exclusion.criterion: Objective intellectual impairment (estimated IQ < 70)
exclusion.plain: Check neuropsych testing for estimated IQ < 70

exclusion.criterion: Any history of Electroconvulsive Therapy or psychosis (except postictal psychosis for patients)
exclusion.plain: Check for any past ECT, or psychosis that was not postictal

exclusion.criterion: Psychotic disorder (lifetime)

exclusion.criterion: Current Anxiety disorder, Major Depressive Disorder, or Bipolar Disorder

exclusion.criterion: Neurodegenerative disease, widespread brain lesions, or language problems (other than naming difficulty)
exclusion.plain: Check imaging and neuro notes; naming difficulty alone does not exclude

exclusion.criterion: Medical conditions that could affect cognitive performance (e.g., HIV infection, cancer with metastatic potential)
exclusion.plain: Check medical history for HIV, cancer with metastatic potential, or similar conditions

exclusion.criterion: Acute renal failure or end-stage renal disease
exclusion.plain: Check renal history and labs for AKI or ESRD

screening_notes: Review the sEEG implant plan with the epilepsy/neurosurgery team to confirm hippocampal head, body and tail electrodes.
Reading level (7th grade) and English/Spanish proficiency may need a direct assessment.
Estimated IQ < 70 needs neuropsych testing or an IQ estimate.
Psychiatric exclusions need a clinical interview: current anxiety disorder, MDD or bipolar disorder; lifetime psychotic disorder; psychosis other than postictal; any past ECT.
Hearing and corrected vision (newspaper at arm's length) may need a bedside check.
Renal status (AKI/ESRD): check labs or chart.
e02ad7f228ab91683f7b8d9318ce127f379130da.compensation: Not stated in the registry record; ask the study team.
e02ad7f228ab91683f7b8d9318ce127f379130da.benefits: None stated in the registry record.
e02ad7f228ab91683f7b8d9318ce127f379130da.involves: Observational, no placebo. During inpatient intracranial epilepsy monitoring, passive neural, physiological, behavioral and environmental recordings plus adaptive EMAs and memory tasks; number of visits and duration not stated.

c6ccdb53f21607c38516043dcbcaac8f65d65c41.overview: This is a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of ITI-1284 given alone (monotherapy) to adults 18 years and older. inclusion.plain: Confirm age ≥18

inclusion.criterion: Written informed consent before any study-specific procedures
inclusion.plain: Patient able and willing to consent

inclusion.criterion: DSM-5-TR moderate or severe current GAD confirmed by SCID-5-CT (Investigator or Sponsor-approved rater) at Screening
inclusion.plain: Current GAD diagnosis, moderate or severe

inclusion.criterion: HAM-A Total score ≥ 22 at Screening and Baseline
inclusion.plain: Rated HAM-A total ≥ 22 at both visits

inclusion.criterion: HAM-A Items 1 (anxious mood) and 2 (tension) scores ≥ 2 at Screening and Baseline
inclusion.plain: HAM-A items 1 and 2 each ≥ 2

inclusion.criterion: CGI-S score ≥ 4 at Screening and Baseline
inclusion.plain: CGI-S ≥ 4

inclusion.plain: Chart shows ≥2 adequate-dose, ≥6-week trials of listed GAD drugs with <50% improvement

exclusion.criterion: Lifetime DSM-5-TR schizophrenia, schizoaffective, schizophreniform, or other psychotic disorder

exclusion.criterion: Lifetime DSM-5-TR Bipolar Disorder
exclusion.plain: Any lifetime bipolar diagnosis

exclusion.plain: Significant comorbid depression on MADRS

exclusion.criterion: Significant risk of suicidal behavior during the study, in the Investigator's opinion

exclusion.plain: Recent active suicidal ideation with intent/plan

exclusion.plain: Any suicide attempt in past 2 years

exclusion.criterion: MADRS Item 10 score ≥ 5 at Screening or Baseline
exclusion.plain: High MADRS suicidal thoughts item

exclusion.criterion: Imminent danger to self or others per Investigator
exclusion.plain: Acute safety risk

screening_notes: SCID-5-CT structured interview by the Investigator or a Sponsor-approved rater to confirm GAD and rule out psychotic and bipolar disorders
HAM-A (total plus items 1 and 2) and CGI-S ratings are required at both Screening and Baseline
MADRS (total and Item 10) at Screening and Baseline
C-SSRS at Screening (6-month lookback) and at Baseline (since Screening)

Monotherapy design: the record does not give washout or concomitant medication rules; confirm with the study team

c6ccdb53f21607c38516043dcbcaac8f65d65c41.benefits: None stated in the registry record.
c6ccdb53f21607c38516043dcbcaac8f65d65c41.involves: ITI-1284 alone vs placebo, randomized and double-blind; the record doesn't give dose, visit schedule, or study length.

50149899372027d470e31f75daf57ff0c3fc6d64.overview: This study wants adults with severe, treatment-refractory OCD who have already decided, for clinical reasons and separately from the study, to get ALIC DBS with a directional system. Before surgery, each patient gets a 7T MRI, and leads are placed in a personalized way to target five ALIC white-matter pathways. The aim is to map which pathways are linked to the best therapeutic response.

inclusion.criterion: Primary psychiatric diagnosis of OCD per DSM-5

inclusion.criterion: Meets FDA HDE criteria for indication (chronic, severe, treatment-refractory OCD; failed at least three SSRIs)
inclusion.plain: Check that the HDE indication is met

inclusion.plain: Assess capacity to consent

inclusion.plain: Assess willingness and ability to follow study procedures

exclusion.criterion: Ineligible or unwilling to receive ALIC DBS for OCD
exclusion.plain: Check surgical eligibility and willingness

exclusion.criterion: Contraindication to general anesthesia, neurosurgery, or MRI
exclusion.plain: Check anesthesia, surgical, and MRI contraindications

exclusion.criterion: Neurological disorder or significant brain pathology (moderate/marked atrophy, stroke, tumor, epilepsy, prior neurosurgery; cingulotomy may be permitted)
exclusion.plain: Review neuro history and imaging

exclusion.criterion: Unstable medical illness, chronic immunosuppression, or considerably reduced life expectancy

exclusion.criterion: Conditions requiring certain regular MRI scans or diathermy
exclusion.plain: Check for ongoing MRI or diathermy needs

exclusion.criterion: Implanted pacemaker/defibrillator or other electrical device that may interfere with DBS or be affected by it (neurosurgeon opinion)
exclusion.plain: Check for implanted devices

exclusion.criterion: Other primary Axis I disorder or any history of psychosis (incl. schizophrenia, psychosis in a depressive/manic episode)

exclusion.criterion: Substance abuse/dependence currently or within the 6 months before implantation (excl. nicotine, caffeine)

bb301188204fcdd9db80f620865368146d216acd.overview: This RCT is for active-duty Department of the Air Force units. It enrolls two groups: service members seeing a BH technician, and the embedded BH technicians themselves.

inclusion.criterion: Age 18 years or older (no upper age limit); any sex

inclusion.criterion: Service members seeing a behavioral health (BH) technician
inclusion.plain: Confirm the service member is currently seeing a BH technician

inclusion.criterion: Currently embedded BH technicians
inclusion.plain: Confirm the technician is currently embedded in an operational unit

exclusion.criterion: Service members who are not currently seeing a BH technician
exclusion.plain: Exclude if not currently seeing a BH technician

For technicians, confirm current embedded status and that they have not moved to a clinic role.

bb301188204fcdd9db80f620865368146d216acd.benefits: None stated in the registry record.
bb301188204fcdd9db80f620865368146d216acd.involves: Randomized comparison of BH technicians trained in the IOS evidence-based intervention toolkit vs. routine care with standard resources; visit schedule, duration, and placebo use not stated.

1a7160e43377ec611bbccec3f2760f179948fd79.overview: This trial is looking for Black and Latino adults in Harlem, aged 18–65, who screen at moderate risk for depression (PHQ-4 ≥3). It tests whether a community coalition can improve access to mental health care and links to services. In the model, community health workers screen, educate, and refer patients, working alongside primary care, behavioral health, and social services.

inclusion.criterion: Black or Latino adults aged 18 to 65 years
inclusion.plain: Confirm the patient is Black or Latino and aged 18–65

inclusion.criterion: Harlem resident from low-income housing developments or receiving primary care services in Harlem
inclusion.plain: Confirm the patient lives in Harlem low-income housing or gets primary care in Harlem

inclusion.criterion: PHQ-4 Total Score ≥3, moderate risk for depression
inclusion.plain: Check for a recent PHQ-4 total score of ≥3

1a7160e43377ec611bbccec3f2760f179948fd79.compensation: Not stated in the registry record; ask the study team.
1a7160e43377ec611bbccec3f2760f179948fd79.benefits: None stated in the registry record.

1de5da78699b4f4c44b14a8e3f450f3ef25c6af8.overview: Decentralized, open-label, single-arm exploratory study of daily Neuralli Mood (probiotic L. plantarum PS128 + heat-treated L. paracasei PS23) in generally healthy adults aged 18+ with stress, occasional sleep disruption, low mood, anxiety, or burnout. 51a4cab908517ea2364ac967b9ac534631b673e9.overview: This study looks at the brain basis of anxiety during early and long-term (protracted) abstinence in alcohol use disorder (AUD). It plans to enroll 40 treatment-seeking adults with AUD, who will start disulfiram, and 20 age-matched healthy volunteers. fMRI will measure anterior insula, BNST and DLPFC activity during a threat-anxiety task, plus resting-state connectivity, and relate them to anxiety symptoms. Ages 21 to 55, any sex.

inclusion.plain: Check date of birth: 21 to 55

inclusion.criterion: Right-handed (both groups)

840e09d80aff1b2c5a5298cee113d79f2fbf52bb.overview: This trial is for adults scheduled for primary THA, TKA, or UKA for osteoarthritis under spinal/regional anesthesia. exclusion.criterion: Hearing impairment precluding music listening

exclusion.plain: Check for any active psychiatric diagnosis being treated with current psychotropic medication

840e09d80aff1b2c5a5298cee113d79f2fbf52bb.compensation: Not stated in the registry record; ask the study team.

The study collects biological, psychological, and social markers (inflammation, hormones, speech, behavior, personality, social determinants) during routine treatment. It is testing whether music therapy, plus recitals at Third Street Music School Settlement, helps with depression and resilience. Children watch and talk with the performers and discuss performance anxiety and what it's like to share their creative work.

It compares ERP delivered by VA telehealth (VTH) with a stress management training control. The goal is to see whether ERP improves functioning, quality of life, and OCD symptoms in all participants and in the OCD+PTSD subgroup, and to judge how well ERP could be rolled out in VA mental health care.
